description: Hybrid fault detector (integrity rules + segment-aware transient detector + targeted GBT / stuck rule + tuned CUSUM) compared with each component and the Milestone-4 detectors on the fresh v3 synthetic suite.

splits.final_evaluation: test (scored once, after settings are frozen)

context_note: Context windows for false-alarm reporting are fixed per measurand (temperature: 6 x the slowest assumed probe time constant of 35 s; current: 3 x the 45 s shunt thermal time constant). CUSUM transition-exclusion windows are candidates tuned on calibration+validation runs; they apply after protocol set-point changes into segments without an explicit settling phase. Neither uses device-specific simulation parameters.

cusum.selection_rule: calibration+validation runs only: ARL0 (Siegmund) >= 10 x longest error series, zero alarms on signal-fault-free runs, zero pre-onset alarms on drift runs; then most drift runs detected, then lowest median delay, then largest ARL0. If no configuration has zero false alarms, the fewest false alarms wins first.

hybrid_selection_rule: per measurand, on validation runs: maximise event-level F1 = harmonic mean of macro timely event recall (over signal fault classes) and alarm-episode precision; ties broken by fewer false-alarm episodes per hour
static_calibration: CalibrationEngine.select_best_model (F-test + BIC, degree <= 3) on each device's calibration sweep (calibration partition)
segment_mad_note: Modified-z threshold of the existing DataQualityAssessor inside the hybrid's transient component (3.5 = existing default). Quantisation makes the MAD collapse to the quantisation step for low-noise channels, so 3.5 can correspond to ~2.6 sigma; the threshold is selected on validation runs. The stand-alone existing detector keeps 3.5.
